title: Gwinnett Goal Club celebrates best in 2026 high school soccer - NewsBreak
text:
By From Staff Reports ,
4 hours ago The top individual award-winners pose for photos at the Gwinnett Goal Club's season-ending celebration at Hebron Christian on May 18, 2026. Pictured, left to right, are Wesleyan's Glenn Archer (Class -A Girls Coach of the Year), Wesleyan's Mary Mac Brown ( -A Girls Player of the Year), Brookwood's Skylar Schroder ( Girls Player of the Year), Brookwood's Michael Tolmich ( Girls Coach of the Year), Meadowcreek's Alexandre Diouf ( Boys Player of the Year), Buford's Mike Wentzler ( Boys Coach of the Year), GAC's Thom Jacquet ( -A Boys Coach of the Year) and GAC's Jaidan Tabb ( -A Boys Player of the Year). By Oscar Guevara Saenz The Gwinnett Goal Club honored the best in 2026 high school soccer with a season-ending celebration at Hebron Christian on Monday.
Brookwood and Wesleyan swept the top girls awards, including Brookwood’s Skylar Schroder as Class Player of the Year and Wesleyan’s Mary Mac Brown as -A Player of the Year. The Coach of the Year awards for the girls went to Brookwood’s Michael Tolmich in and Wesleyan’s Glenn Archer in -A.
The Greater Atlanta Christian boys program earned both -A awards with Jaidan Tabb as Player of the Year and Thom Jacquet as Coach of the Year.
In boys, Meadowcreek’s Alexandre Diouf was Player of the Year and Buford’s Mike Wentzler was Coach of the Year.
